rationale.text: A script widget is shown in place of the native select, which is hidden with display none and holds optgroups without a label attribute. The test gives no exception for hidden lists, but it does not say whether a native list hidden behind a scripted replacement is one it covers. The custom check answers cannot_tell when the select is not rendered (step 2); only the record supports this branch. The finding is needs_review at both levels: not_enabled at fail_only, cannot_tell at full.

citations.quote: Dans chaque balise `<select>`, chaque balise `<optgroup>` possède-t-elle un attribut `label` ?
